title: Doesn’t get real cold.
text: Doesn’t get real cold.. Outer metal shell gets really hot when motor is running, hence instruction not to enclose in a cabinet etc. Doesn’t get real cold. I had to turn it up to chill soft drinks and water, and freeze tiny ice cubes. Took overnight. But it was inexpensive, would suggest you upgrade if you would use for a dorm or deer camp, etc. it’s ok for my use, which s having chilled water after I mow the lawn.

product_metadata.title: FRIGIDAIRE Coral EFR176- AMZ Retro Mini Refrigerator-Energy Saving-Adjustable Thermostat Control-Side Mounted Bottle Opener-Ideal for for Dorm, Office, RV, Garage, Apartment 1.6 Cubic Feet
features: RETRO DESIGN - Our refrigerator has a stylish retro appearance with a traditional handle and current technologies such as an R600a energy-efficient compressor that cools food quicker while using less electricity.

ENERGY SAVING AND QUIET - Thanks to its low-noise construction, this tiny refrigerator has a noise level of less than 37dB, offering a comfortable and quiet indoor atmosphere for your living and working circumstances.

ADJUSTABLE TEMPERATURE - Our mini refrigerator's thermostat control offers several temperature settings for better adaptation to external temperature and lower energy bills. This tiny refrigerator also has a light-degree freezing storage compartment for ice cubes.

REMOVABLE SHELVES - It comes with 2 removable shelves that make it easy to clean and make space for additional storage. The shelves are spill-proof and slide out to make cleanup easier while preventing liquids from seeping onto objects below.

HELPFUL FEATURES - The reversible door provides a place for your favorite canned beverages, and you may open the door from either the left or right by adjusting the reversible door hinge. The leveling Leg aids in stable placement on uneven terrain. Equipped with a side-mounted bottle opener, which is quite useful when you need to open a bottle but can't find the bottle opener.
description: When you hear the Frigidaire name, immediately you think of quality built, affordable kitchen products. Well the folks at Frigidaire are at it again. Introducing the Retro, FR176, 1. 6 CU. FT compact refrigerator!   Frigidaire stepped up their game as they introduce this ideal refrigerator that screams dorm room! It comes all ready for your game days with an attached bottle opener, slide out shelves for easy cleaning, an interior freezer with an ice cube tray with an adjustable thermostat so you can keep your two liters of bottle storage at the perfect temperature. With the flush back design, adjustable feet and reversible door, the Retro can go just about anywhere. All this from the makers at Frigidaire, the #1 leader in refrigeration! .
